alerts.description:

Longview, Beckville, Logansport...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Sabine River near Mineola.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning to Thursday evening.

picnic and recreational areas flooded as well.  Also expect flooded
boat ramps as well.

- At 1:15 PM CDT Monday the stage was 12.7 feet.

above flood stage Tuesday morning to a crest of 14.6 feet
Wednesday morning. It will then fall below flood stage early
Thursday morning.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 15.1
feet on 02/27/2016.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
